parties: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited (KIMS); Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIB)
headline: KIMS receives NSE listing approval for 1.99 crore QIP equity shares at Rs. 2/- par
sum: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences received NSE approval to list 1,98,67,549 equity shares of Rs. 2/- each to qualified institutional buyers via qualified institutional placement. The listing intimation marks the completion of the QIP capital raise mechanism.
detail: The NSE General Updates filing dated 23 June 2026 confirms receipt of listing approval for 1,98,67,549 shares at Rs. 2/- par value each through qualified institutional placement. The listing intimation confirms that the QIP mechanism has progressed to the post-allotment listing stage. QIPs under SEBI Regulations allow listed companies to raise capital from qualifying institutional investors (mutual funds, insurance companies, foreign institutional investors) without a public offering prospectus. The Rs. 2/- per share figure represents the nominal/par value; the actual subscription price would have been determined at the QIP pricing window and disclosed separately in the board/institutional announcements.
